views.task_interaction: 沿用数据查询页；验收者按固定输入/查询清单验证，无新性能操作面板
views.state_behavior: 批次幂等、固定提交前沿和完整分页；采集不当作命令完成
views.ui_consumer: 实际云接收UTC、来源、固定前沿及查询是否完整；不拿发送时间证明端到端
views.deployment_verification: 百万、10路30min和查询30+30；后端规模/数据库验收保留

cloud_timestamp.internal: chrono::DateTime<chrono::Utc>, candidate chrono0.4.45; explicit serde/schema/TS wrapper
cloud_timestamp.input: uppercase T; Z or known numeric offset; actual calendar; local and normalized UTC year0001..9999; 0..6 fraction digits; reject -00:00 and seconds60
cloud_timestamp.database: timestamptz(6); tokio-postgres0.7.18 with-chrono-0_4; no string timezone comparison
cloud_timestamp.generation: schema date-time+pattern and actual semantic parser; TS string; no ordinary String/default chrono serde equivalence claim
cloud_timestamp.not_changed: free-form device_timestamp, v1 external schemas and Host monotonic milliseconds

query_semantics.normalization: typed UTC; device_ids sorted/deduplicated; [] all authorized devices in selected dataset
query_semantics.minute: UTC floor; nonempty groups; order bucket_start/device_id/source_mode; zero-based row_index
query_semantics.frontier: every page including empty/last; ingress<=F; F is committed prefix, not filtered row count
query_semantics.unsigned_cursor: no authorization or original-issue authenticity; F<=current and valid filter/identity/position; consumer compares original F
query_semantics.device_membership: [] resolves authorized present devices at fixed F, explicit authorized ids retained without rows; normalized cursor binds resolved set; every result echoes same actual set

write_semantics.time: DB clock_timestamp once after dataset lock/dedup per new TX04 event or TX10 batch; exact retry keeps original time; wall time may step backwards
write_semantics.batch_ordinal: 0..N-1; same batch requires exact N/order/canonical typed payload
write_semantics.new_batch_collision: any reused dataset/device_ref/sequence conflicts whole batch even equal payload; no successful all-reused under unstored new batch id

generated_fixture.identity: TX13 preseeded dedicated generated dataset; first import requires empty dataset; G000..G099 and batch-load-0000..0999; repeated measurement reuses original immutable fixture/batch identities
generated_fixture.close: quiesce generated dataset before timing; expected F0 from actual committed dataset row
generated_fixture.oracle: readonly raw DB export<=F0 plus generation formula; independent Python stdlib identity bitset/field check and UTC filter/group; not C08 or SQL aggregate as its own oracle
generated_fixture.correctness: all million identities once and exact fields; all raw API pages and full minute aggregate equal independent expected; no checksum layer
generated_fixture.repeat: No dataset creation endpoint: initial two nonexecution datasets come from same deployment configuration/TX13. Repeat query groups reuse fixed million and F0; no claim of newly inserting a million. A changed fixture needs separately configured initial deployment, no automatic DB reset.

query_manifest.freeze: after raw DB export, before timed queries; deterministic recipes from actual stored UTC times; note actual platform/client/region, no credentials
query_manifest.raw_recipe: j0..29: G{j:03d}, sort10000 rows by(cloud_received_at,ingress); inclusive ranks1000+10j..1099+10j -> [lo_time,hi_time+1us); keep all timestamp ties
query_manifest.aggregate_recipe: all100 devices; sort million rows by(cloud_received_at,ingress); j0..29 inclusive ranks10000j..999999-10000j -> [lo_time,hi_time+1us); include ties; nominal spans1M..420000
query_manifest.performance: API-only complete logical query; monotonic first request start through final page read/decoded; includes connection/queue/network/pages; compare precomputed expected separately; UI100 frames separate
query_manifest.warmup: one fixed warmup per query kind, labelled before30+30; no individually warming measured queries or cache flushing requirement
query_manifest.order: R00,A00,R01,A01..R29,A29; serial logical queries; keep all60 original outcomes; no dropping slow/failure or first-page-only timing
query_manifest.p95: nearest rank ceil(0.95*30)=29 per group; any missing/failed/incorrect planned query prevents full group pass

live_producers.purpose: telemetry_only; distinct dataset and per-process boot; not ten execution workers
live_producers.cadence: own monotonic anchor after preflight; seq1..1800; actual sample creation and initial request start in own[k,k+1)second slot; run>=1800s; no burst catch-up for missed slots
live_producers.retries: same boot/sequence/payload; record actual attempts/ack; final counts alone not continuity proof; each new campaign uses new process boot identities; DB membership check isolates these10 boots/seq1..1800, not total historical dataset row count
live_producers.cloud_minute_expectation: actual DB receive timestamps; not forced60 per UTC minute at boundaries/jitter
live_producers.overlap: generated dataset loaded/quiesced first; queries may run in predeclared live interval; record actual overlap, no unexecuted concurrency claim

design_cases.trigger: offset等价、7位小数、非法日期及秒60
design_cases.expected: UTC微秒规范；非法拒绝；from=until为空，反向422；Host时间独立

design_cases.trigger: 混合事件及时间/分钟边界
design_cases.expected: 排除receipt；云时间半开区间与UTC分钟；发送时间不代替入库时间

design_cases.trigger: 分页中写入、空末页及篡改游标
design_cases.expected: 各页同dataset/F且<=F；F越前沿/筛选冲突拒绝；unsigned游标不证明首次签发

design_cases.trigger: 重试/缩短/追加/重排及跨batch复用身份
design_cases.expected: 仅原批精确重试复用原时间；其他整批冲突不推进前沿

design_cases.trigger: 百万输入缺失/重复/错内容，查询存在聚合bug
design_cases.expected: 公式逐身份/字段核对DB原始导出；独立预期对完整API页；不能只看数量或自证聚合
完整查询计时；60原样本保留；正确性/完整性均满足；p95第29项<=2秒

design_cases.trigger: 最终18000条但断线/补发/漏采
design_cases.expected: 验证10进程各1800实际1秒槽及发送；补发不修复连续性；不增加生产接受量

design_cases.trigger: 空设备选择、无命中及跨范围查询
design_cases.expected: []仅授权dataset内设备；无命中空结果仍含F；显式越权403；普通读者无DB权限

field_help.consumer: L29/L30固定字段帮助及独立API示例，不新增字段编辑器

field_help.model_ms: 模型虚拟毫秒及实际computed frontier，不作现场性能

field_help.count: 每个聚合明确是事件数或命令状态数，不等于接受量

field_help.state: 枚举/布尔无物理单位；明确字段含义及来源
